recommendation: Keep the source fix. Future work is only needed if Patient Care or terminology reviewers choose additional person-role concepts or a different SNOMED CT expression for caregiver roles.
issue_request: FHIR-33956 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding SNOMED CT 429577009 Patient advocate (person), 116154003 Patient (person), and 133932002 Caregiver (person) to CareTeam.participant.role after the broader Person include had been removed. The final resolution specified no children for Patient advocate and Patient, and Caregiver with descendants.
initial_application: Git commit 63992ae434885cd5c252c61ad1c73c890e0620d2, merged through PR #2294, added the three requested SNOMED CT concepts to source/careteam/valueset-participant-role.xml. That application left Caregiver as a single enumerated concept instead of an is-a include for descendants and left the older FHIR-20566 description that named only Healthcare professional and Services.
additional_context: FHIR-20566 is the earlier cleanup that removed the broad is-a 125676002 Person include and changed the participant-role definition to Healthcare professional or Services. Patient Care and LHS minutes confirm FHIR-33956 should be a targeted restoration of unpaid person-role concepts, including caregiver descendants such as primary caregiver and informal caregiver. CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini and the edited file is the current CareTeam value set source.
reconciliation: Changed source/careteam/valueset-participant-role.xml so 429577009 and 116154003 remain explicit no-children concepts, 133932002 is represented as a SNOMED is-a filter to include Caregiver and descendants, and the description names the full current definition.
source_changes: source/careteam/valueset-participant-role.xml: updated the ValueSet description to include Patient advocate, Patient, Caregiver and descendants, Healthcare professional, and Services.

source/careteam/valueset-participant-role.xml: replaced the single 133932002 Caregiver concept entry with an is-a 133932002 filter, preserving the explicit no-children entries for 429577009 and 116154003.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published cleanup removed the broad Person hierarchy from this value set; FHIR-33956 is a targeted restoration, not a full reversal.
